lead: Discover 2,000 years of history with official tourist guides: the Cathedral, La Lonja de la Seda (UNESCO heritage), El Carmen district, the Plaza de la Virgen and much more.
The three most recommended routes for getting to know Valencia in depth.

items.kicker: Walking tour · 2 hours · Official guide · Available all year round
items.title: Essential Valencia and its World Heritage Sites
items.subtitle: Spanish · English · Italian · French · 10% off with VTC · Rated 4.9/5
items.body: The most complete tour to discover the soul of Valencia in two hours. An official tourist guide leads the route past the most emblematic monuments of the historic centre: the Cathedral and the Holy Chalice, La Lonja de la Seda (a World Heritage Site), the Serranos Towers, the Plaza de la Virgen and the Basilica of the Virgen de los Desamparados, the Central Market and El Carmen district. The route combines the great medieval landmarks with the everyday stories of the Valencia of always: its myths, legends, traditions and the cuisine that was born in these streets. Available in Spanish, English, Italian and French. Ideal for first-time visitors to Valencia who want to get their bearings from day one with the cultural context needed to understand the city.
facts: 2 hours · On foot through the historic centre · Bilingual official tourist guide
From €18.00 per person · 10% discount with the Valencia Tourist Card
Available all year round · Check timetables and available sessions on the website

items.kicker: Walking tour · 2 hours · Sundays 11:00 · Lonja admission included
items.title: City Tour: culture, trade and a visit inside La Lonja de la Seda
items.subtitle: Spanish · English · Italian · French · Lonja admission included · 10% off with VTC · 5/5
items.body: A special guided visit that includes access to the interior of La Lonja de la Seda, the most important Gothic civil building in Spain and one of the most impressive in Europe. Declared a UNESCO World Heritage Site in 1996, the route reveals the Columned Hall, the Tower and the Consulate of the Sea with all its medieval merchant history. Besides the interior of La Lonja, the tour walks the historic shopping streets of Valencia, the Central Market, the Plaza del Mercado and the surroundings of the Old Town, explaining how the silk trade turned Valencia into one of the richest cities of the Mediterranean in the 15th century. Available on Sundays at 11:00.
facts: 2 hours · Admission to the interior of La Lonja de la Seda included in the price
From €18.00 · 10% discount with the Valencia Tourist Card

items.title: Art and architecture tour of the old town
items.subtitle: Spanish · English · Italian · Admissions included · 10% off with VTC · 5/5
items.body: The most complete and in-depth tour of the historic centre, designed for art and architecture lovers. Over 3 hours, a specialist guide uncovers the historical and artistic layers of medieval, Gothic, Renaissance and Baroque Valencia, including admission to the most important monuments on the route. The tour analyses in detail the architecture of the Cathedral, La Lonja, the Palacio del Marqués de Dos Aguas and the churches of El Carmen district, placing the works in the context of the artistic movements of each period. Ideal for travellers with a deep cultural interest who want to go far beyond a superficial visit.
facts: 3 hours · Admission to monuments included in the tour price
From €45.00 · 10% discount with the Valencia Tourist Card

items.title: València, city of the Holy Chalice
items.subtitle: Friday · 10:00 · Cathedral admission included · 2 h
items.body: A route along the Holy Chalice trail, the chalice that according to tradition was used by Jesus at the Last Supper and is kept in Valencia Cathedral. Includes admission to the Cathedral.

items.body: A route through the Valencian settings that inspired the painter Joaquín Sorolla: the streets, the Mediterranean light, the beach and the district that shaped his work and his view of the world.

items.body: Discover Valencia’s most important festival throughout the whole year. A tour that explains the origin, rituals, characters and key places of Las Fallas, a World Heritage festival.

items.title: Admission to the Church of San Nicolás — the Valencian Sistine Chapel
items.subtitle: Tuesday to Sunday · 45 min – 1h 15 min · Audio guide in 6 languages
items.body: The Church of San Nicolás houses one of the most impressive painted ceilings in the world: 1,600 m² of 17th-century Baroque frescoes that completely cover the vault and walls, creating a visual effect comparable to the Sistine Chapel. Audio guide available in Spanish, English, Italian and French.

blocks.title: Tips for visiting the historic centre of Valencia
items: The best time for the tour is early in the morning (9–11 h): less heat, fewer tourists and better light for photographing the monuments
If you only have time for one tour, choose Essential Valencia and its World Heritage Sites: in 2 hours you see the key points with real historical context
The Church of San Nicolás (the Valencian Sistine Chapel) can be visited independently from €16; the ceiling frescoes are absolutely impressive
The Holy Chalice tour (Friday 10:00) includes admission to the Cathedral: the only way to see up close the chalice that according to tradition Jesus used at the Last Supper
With the Valencia Tourist Card you get 10–15% off almost every tour in the historic centre
El Carmen district is ideal for exploring at your own pace after the tour: medieval alleys, art galleries, murals and the best selection of tapas terraces
